[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] owned '''a freighter'''<ref name="Lucky" /> in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="timeline">The framing story of "[[Lucky (comic story)|Lucky]]" is set "a couple of weeks" after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] (in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] according to the [[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]) while the flashbacks take place "six years earlier".</ref> He delivered goods to and from [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]] in it.<ref name="Lucky" />
